item.title: Re: Question about formatting?
item.content:encoded: Thank you, Zyn! I will keep that in mind. The bullet point is a good idea.

item.title: Re: Question about formatting?
item.content:encoded:
i was wondering if I could add a "Special Transportation Procedures (or Protocols)" section AFTER the containment procedures section?

There's nothing that says you can't, though readers may wonder why you don't just make a bullet-point list of transportation information in the containment procedures. Also, if the transportation information is heavily bogged down with logistical minutiae, readers might just lose interest in the material and skip that section entirely.

Would that take away from my rating?

It probably wouldn't cause an immediate downvote, but it might give readers either a confusing or negative impression of the piece if there doesn't seem to be a need to separate transportation information entirely.

item.title: Question about formatting?
item.content:encoded:
Hey everyone, new member here.
